text: Acceptance 4/5: claiming a refreshed record temporarily hides its wake target. In-memory pruneSessions reproduction: refresh in afterSelect; submit a valid signed wake in afterClaim -> 202 woke:false, reason='no recorded session'; after restoration, retry -> 409 replay; runner calls=0. The wake is permanently lost although the refreshed record survives. Synchronize wake reads with pruning or safely expose claimed fresh records to readers.
